es: ApliArte Glass Theme. La forma más fácil de darle a tu app Flutter un efecto glass morphism sin cambiar nada de tu código. Solo instalá el paquete, cambia el import y todos tus componentes AppBar, Card, NavigationBar, FAB y Drawer se vuelven de vidrio esmerilado. Funciona en dark y light automáticamente. Tiene preset warm, indicador deslizante y es completamente open source. Probálo hoy.
en: ApliArte Glass Theme. The easiest way to give your Flutter app a glass morphism effect without changing any code. Just install the package, change the import, and all your components AppBar, Card, NavigationBar, FAB, and Drawer become frosted glass. Works in dark and light mode automatically. Has warm preset, sliding indicator, and is fully open source. Try it today.

it: ApliArte Glass Theme. Il modo più semplice per dare alla tua app Flutter un effetto glass morphism senza cambiare nessuna linea di codice.
